beaches.name: Camp Baldarin beaches (Punta Križa)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is required on the naturist-section beaches of Camp Baldarin. The operator's house rules state that no clothing is permitted on the beach there and that minors may be clothed only where marked on the camp map; Bokinić beach at the camp entrance serves the textile quarter. Day visitors check in at reception and pay an entrance fee.
